blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Two people were killed and two others were wounded in an explosion outside LCC Market and Department Store along Tara Street in Barangay Pating, Masbate City, on Saturday afternoon, Nov. 14. Police Lt. Col. Maria Luisa Calubaquib, Bicol police spokesperson, said initial findings indicated that the incident was caused by a pressurized biogas explosion, based on coordination with the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) and the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO). However, these initial findings remain subject to confirmation pending laboratory examination of soil samples and swab specimens collected from the scene by the Police […]...
